profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Federato
profile.summary:
https://github.com/tindn/resume

2013-2018: building full stack web applications*
  Focus on working across back-end and front-end to deliver complete software solutions.
  Stack: .NET, ReactJS, AngularJS, Node.js, MS SQL, MySQL, C#, JavaScript, SQL, HTML, CSS.

2018 - 2023: building delightful mobile apps for Android and iOS using React Native
  Focus on product development, mentoring junior engineers, and setting technical foundations.
  Stack:  React Native, ReactJS, NestJS, NodeJS, PostgreSQL, SQLite, TypeScript, SQL.

2024 - now: building LLM-powered features & agentic products
  Find PMF for new agentic products while applying good software engineering to LLM-powered apps.
  Stack: GPT & Claude models, LangChain, OpenAI SDK, FastAPI, Temporal, Python, TypeScript.

positions.description:
Klaviyo Composer Agent, an AI assistant for autonomous marketing workflows.

Klaviyo Customer Service Agent, enabling ecomm brands to provide on-brand and personalized customer support.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Launched the NDVR Wealth mobile app, a consumer finance app for optimizing and tracking investment portfolios.

Set the foundation for the web app and component library.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and deployed mobile apps for clients including:

Real time service job tracking app for field technicians.
Offline first TV and film production management app SyncOnSet.
Library management and research assistant app for EBSCO Information Services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Built in house software to optimize warehouse operations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Digital workplace applications for GE employees worldwide.
Knowledge management and export control system for GE Aviation.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Unemployment Insurance management system for the State of Iowa.
Agricultural Insurance product for Farmers Mutual Hail Insurance Company of Iowa.
Contract and resident management software for memory care facilities.
Deployed ERP software with Microsoft Dynamics GP for businesses across Iowa.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed websites for clients with Drupal CMS and Wordpress CMS.

positions.title: Digital Media Assistant
positions.description:
I provided support and troubleshooting for students with multimedia projects such as sound and movie editing, publication, photo editing, etc. using Adobe Creative Suites, Garage Bands and Final Cut.

I held workshops on educational technologies such as LaTex, Wordpress, MATLAB to teach students about these useful programs.

I worked with faculty to provide in-class technical support for multimedia projects.

positions.title: Social Entrepreneurship Consultant
positions.description:
This was a semester long seminar, during which I leaned about business analysis and consultation for non-profit organizations.

I worked in a team of 3 to consult a local customer on a retail store with a mission for community development.

We prepared a business plan and participated in a local business idea competition.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Build custom websites with Drupal CMS, HTML, CSS, and jQuery

positions.title: Finance Intern
positions.description:
I worked full-time with other financial analysts in the office to transition financial reports into new reporting styles during the change of ownership of the company. The process required the analysis of existing reports and reformatting of old reports to new ones. 

For the project, I built a relational database in Microsoft Access using Visual Basics for Microsoft to store data exported from SAP. I then wrote custom Excel functions that automatically generate financial reports from the Access database.

organizations.name: College of Wooster Hans H. Jenny Investment Club
organizations.description:
I participate in the management of US $ 3 million of the college endowment fund, using long-term investment strategies

I research and analyze business portfolios of high-growth, small to medium sized companies

Based on these analyses, I then present them to the board of trustees. We will then discuss and vote on the investment decision

organizations.name: College of Wooster Residence Life
organizations.description:
I served as an in-residence student leader for new students, helped them to orientate into the new college environment

I mediated conflict resolution among residents

I also organized community events and served as the communication channel between the school administration and the students
